Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this first game. It was quite a fascinating encounter and there is another cracking contest coming our way shortly. It will be Barbados Women going up against Pakistan Women at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Our build-up though begins in advance. So do join us for the same. Cheers!

Earlier in the day, India, after electing to bat, put up a fighting total on the board courtesy Harmanpreet Kaur and Shafali Verma. That though was not enough as Australia chased it down despite being 5 down for below 50. Australia Women were good with the ball as well and that allowed them to chase down this total despite not starting well with the bat.

India started off brilliant, we should actually say Renuka Singh was the tormentor in chief. She got 4 quickly and Sharma also chipped in with one. However, the two did not get a lot of support. The likes of Meghna Singh, Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad were quite poor, they just were not upto the mark with the ball. Had they bowled well, the story could have well been different. India will feel, they had the game in their grasp and it will be a difficult loss to swallow.

Let me remind you, Australia, chasing 155 were reeling at 49-5. They lost all the big names for not a lot, the likes of Alyssa Healy, Tahlia McGrath. Meg Lanning, Rachael Haynes all fell for nothing. The run rate was almost touching 9 but Grace Harris counter attacked. She found the boundaries at will and Garnder at that time was happy to play second fiddle. The two added a 50-plus stand in no time but there was another twist in the game as Harris and Jess Jonassen fell in quick succession. Gardner though kept her cool, King too hit a few good strokes to ease the pressure of her and in the end, it is the Aussies who get over the line.

What a win, what a win for the Aussies! They have just shown why they are the best side in the world at the moment! Take a bow Gardner, what a knock. She showed all her experience and took her side over the line with a fine half ton.

FOUR! That's it! Alana King finishes it off in style! Sharma goes fuller and on off. King slogs it hard through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it but it races away quite quickly and reaches the fence. Australia Women win by 3 wickets!
Slower through the air, on off. King pushes it towards the off side.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it to deep point for a single.

FOUR! That should be the killer blow! Fifty for Ashleigh Gardner as well. What a knock this has been, simply brilliant! Gardner steps out and hits it through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary.
Two more! Outside off, this is cut through point. Two taken.
Shorter and on off, this is played to point.
Shortish delivery on off. Ashleigh Gardner pushes it to long off for as single. 27 from the last two overs!
FOUR! The game is drifting away from India now! This is fuller, on off. Ashleigh Gardner makes room and drives it over extra-cover for a boundary.

Good work by Meghna Singh at long on! Tossed up on middle. Ashleigh Gardner dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground. Singh moves to her left and stops it inside the fence. Two taken.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing now for Australia Women! Short and wide outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it through point for a boundary.
On the shorter side, around off. King drags it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off. King skips down the track and has a mighty swing across the line. However, she mistimes it completely.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it's another boundary for the Aussies! 15 from the over! Short and wide outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it over point for a boundary. 21 needed now from 18 balls!
Angling into the pads. King looks to work i towards the leg side. She misses and the ball goes off her pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
A very full delivery on off. King drives it left of the bowler.
FOUR! Another boundary! A short one again, around off. King goes for a big pull shot. However, she gets the outside edge of her blade and the ball runs away towards the third man fence.

FOUR! Crucial boundary for the Aussies! Singh with a short one on off. King makes room and pulls it towards wide long on. Deol runs to her left and dives, gets her hand to it but ends up deflecting it towards the fence.
Bangs it short and outside off. King upper-cuts it just over short third man for a couple.
Goes quicker on middle. King slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 36 needed now from 24 balls!
Slower through the air on middle. Ashleigh Gardner drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Gardner is key for Australia now! Tossed up, around off. Gardner skips down the track and goes inside-out over extra cover for a boundary.
On the pads. King works it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Tad shorter and around off. King punches it to covers.
A tossed up delivery on leg. King works it to short fine leg.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Another one. King is off the mark! Fuller and on off, this is jammed towards cover for one.
Fuller and on off, King hits it back to mid off.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
Tosses this one outside off, left alone. Wided. The Indians are not happy with that call.
Alana King walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a sharp. sharp catch from Deepti Sharma and India are into the bowling all-rounders now. Still another 45 needed. Jess Jonassen steps out, she does not get to the pitch of it but looks to power it down the ground, she hits it uppishly but straight into the hands of Sharma who takes a sharp catch. India should feel it is their game now.
Shorter and outside off, Jess Jonassen cuts but finds point.
Deepti Sharma is back on. Two overs for 11 runs and a wicket so far.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time and that is yet another good over for the Aussies. 45 needed in 6 now. Shorter and around off, Gardner moves across and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Slightly shorter. Gardner moves across and pulls but towards deep mid-wicket. Only one again.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, Gardner pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Well outside off, left alone.
Kaur gets away with that one! It is short and on the pads, Jess Jonassen pulls, the fielder at short fine leg, dives to her right and makes a good stop.
Jess Jonassen is the new batter for Australia Women and Harmanpreet Kaur comes into the attack now.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a really good catch and quite an important one. Grace Harris walks back after a superb knock but she needed to stay out there for longer. Game swings yet again. This is fuller and on off, holds in the surface a touch. Harris looks to go over mid off but ends up mistiming it towards mid off. Kaur runs back and takes it nicely. 55 more needed in 42. Also, this is Singh's first T20I wicket and it is a vital one.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, Gardner slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Bangs this one short and on middle, it is evaded.

FOUR! Through the leg side this time. 50-run stand up and the game has well and truly turned on its head and it is courtesy this stand! Short, fractionally short. Gardner picks the length up early and pulls it through mid-wicket.

FOUR! Gardner who has not had a lot of strike, gets into act now. She can too hit the ball really hard. This is fuller and on middle, it is hammered past long on for a boundary. The momentum seems to have shifted now.
On the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Another dot to end but yet again, a good over for the Aussies. The run  rate needed has come down a lot. On off, this is pushed to cover.
Flatter and on off, Harris pushes it to covers.
FOUR! 14 from the over with two balls to go. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard wide of long on and into the boundary.

SIX! That is all strength! What a hit. Harris is turning the game single-handedly. She steps out, does not get to the pitch of it but still goes ahead with the shot. It sails over the long on fence for a biggie.
Shorter and outside off, this is chopped to covers.

FOUR! Yet another over which starts with a boundary! This is short and outside off, Harris slaps it through covers for a boundary. Harleen Deol there runs to her right and dives to stop it. However, the ball goes just past her for a boundary.
Two dots to end but the damage was done earlier on! Shortish and outside off, this is cut but to point.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Gardner cuts it to point.
Two more! Shorter and just outside off, Gardner guides it through point. Away from the fielder in the deep and a run is taken.
Takes one now! Shorter and on off, Harris pushes it through covers for one.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Lucky one but Australia won't mind how they come as long as they do. Flatter and outside off, Grace looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge fine on the off side for a boundary.
FOUR! That has been hit with some force! Fuller and outside off, Harris thumps it wide of long off and it races away. Good start to the over. Need to make it count do the Aussies.
Another single to end the over! 89 needed now from 60 balls! Yadav keeps it a tad short and outside off. Harris cuts it to deep point and takes a single.
Bowls it a bit quicker and closer to off. Harris only manages to push it left of the bowler.
On the shorter side again, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it left of sweeper cover for a single.
Pushes it quicker and outside off. Harris cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! That's a clean hit from Harris! A tossed up delivery, on off. Harris uses her feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
Shorter and outside off. Harris looks to cut it but misses.
A full delivery on off. Ashleigh Gardner drives it to mid off. 98 needed now from 66 balls!
A fullish delivery, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner goes chasing for it but misses.

An appeal for a caught behind but the umpire turns it down! Bangs it short, around leg. Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull it but misses. Bhatia collects it and the bowler and keeper appeals but no damage done in the end.
A slower short delivery, outside off. Harris cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Lands on a good length and around off at 107.8 kph. Harris defends it towards point.
Bangs it short, on off. Ashleigh Gardner pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, around off. Harris pushes it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is tad shorter in length and outside off. Harris rocks back and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Shorter in length and outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it to deep point for a single.
A fuller delivery, around off. Harris pushes it to covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fifth wicket down now! This is tossed up, outside off. Haynes looks to drive it away. However, the ball goes off the outside half of her blade aerially towards point. Radha Yadav there takes a simple catch and India are right on top here. Grace Harris is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: On the shorter side and way outside off. Haynes goes way across towards the off side and pulls it to deep backward square leg. She comes back for the second run and Rajeshwari Gayakwad throws it to the batter's end. Bhatia whips the bails off but Haynes is back in the crease as the replays confirm it after the leg umprire took it upstairs.
Run out appeal and it is taken upstairs! Haynes is quite relaxed about it.
Ends her spell with a short delivery on middle. Haynes pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single. End of a superb spell by Renuka Singh! Australia Women need 108 runs from 78 balls!
Sliced away! This is fuller and around off. Haynes slices it over point for a couple.
Another dot ball! This is slower and fuller around off. Haynes looks to paddle it but misses and gets hit on the body.
On a length, on off. Haynes can only manages to defend it off the front foot.
WIDE! Slower and fuller down the leg side. Haynes looks to flick it but misses.
Tad shorter in length, on off. Haynes swipes it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Goes fuller and on off. Haynes drives it off the bounce to Smriti Mandhana at covers.
Another single to end the over. Shorter in length, outside off. Haynes chops it to deep point for a single. Australia Women are 41/4 after the Powerplay!
On the shorter side again, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner goes deep in her crease and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bowls it a tad short, outside off. Haynes cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pushes it a bit quicker, around off. Rachael Haynes looks to cut it but gets the inside edge onto the turf.
Slower through the air, on off. Haynes blocks it off the front foot.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad was expensive, it would be interesting to see how Deepti Sharma goes about her business.
On the shorter side, outside off. Haynes cuts it to point.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
BEATEN YET AGAIN! Renuka Singh is bowling brilliantly! Shorter and outside off, Gardner slashes but misses.
Wonderful bowling! This is a fullish delivery and outside off. There is a hint of inswing into the batter and Gardner looks to drive it away but gets beaten.
BEATEN! Drags her length back just a little, it is outside off again. Garner looks to drive again bvut is beaten.
FOUR! That is a wonderful stroke! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers. Races away. Some shot to get off the mark.
Ashleigh Gardner is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Renuka Singh has 4 and Australia in all sorts of trouble now. This is a gem of a delivery to get rid of a gem of a batter. This one is a big booming inswinger, it comes back in a long way from outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to drive but this one sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and hits the off middle pole.
Quick run! Tahlia McGrath steps out and gets to the pitch of it. She strokes it to mid off and gets to the other end.
Solid! On middle, defended.
FOUR! That has been thumped! Excellent use of the feet! She steps out and gets to the pitch of it. Hammers it down to the long off fence. Third boundary in the over.
A little bit of turn! Flatter and outside off, this lands and turns away. Tahlia McGrath looks to push at it but then bails out.
FOUR! That is beautiful! Absolutely wonderful! Makes room, gets to the pitch of the ball and then strokes it between covers and mid off for a boundary. 8 from the first two balls.
FOUR! Wonderful stroke! Not the start Gayakwad would have wanted! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
Confident start by Haynes! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Rachael Haynes walks out to the middle.

OUT! CHOPS IT ON! Renuka Singh has three and Australia three down in no time and India well and truly on top! Shorter and outside off, Mooney looks to cut but this one stays a touch low. It goes off the inside edge and onto the stumps. This is big, big wicket as we all know the kind of form Mooney has been in.
BEATEN! Good pace from Renuka! Outside off and on a length. Mooney looks to drive but is beaten.

Another loud appeal but not given! The keeper feels it is close and convinces Kaur to take the review. NOT OUT! Replays show that it has pitched outside leg and India lose a review. On the pads, Mooney looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down.
Tahlia McGrath is off the mark! On a length and around off, this is guided through point for one.
Tahlia McGrath is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Renuka strikes again! This time it is the big wicket of Meg Lanning! That is a superb catch by Radha Yadav! This is short and outside off, Lanning cuts but it goes uppishly and low towards point where Radha Yadav dives forward and takes it brilliantly. Game on here. Another 135 needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Finds the gap nicely and that is a productive over for the Aussies! Mooney is really good through the off side. She steps out, pushes this through covers and bags a couple.
This one is banged in short and outside off, Mooney evades it.
Two more! Fuller, tailing back in but on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! The bowling has not been great after that early wicke! This is on the pads, it is tickled fine and it races away to the fence.
Yet again, short and wide outside off, this is cut again but towards deep point so only one. She really nails that cut shot.
FOUR! That was hit way too hard! Lanning loves width and she gets it. It is short and outside off, this is thumped through covers for a boundary.
A successful first over then for India! On off, this is guided to point.
Meghna Singh to start from the other end.
WIDE! Another extra! That is already more wides than Australia bowled in the whole of their innings. Down the leg side. Mooney looks to flick but misses.
Slight fumble and that is two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs there, she does not stop it cleanly and two is taken. Mooney is off the mark too.
Quick run! Fuller and on off, Lanning strokes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
WIDE! Looks to get the ball back in but slips it down the leg side. Wided.
Outstanding fielding! Shorter and outside off, Meg Lanning cuts it through point. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, dives and keeps it down to one. Australia and Lanning are underway.
Meg Lanning is the next batter in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There is the early wicket India needed and it is of the dangerous Alyssa Healy who walks back for a duck! This is on a length and outside off, Alyssa Healy looks to guide it down to third man but this goes off the outside edge and it is taken by Deepti Sharma at first slip.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Good start! On a length and around off, this is guided to point.
